API docs by Redocly

Dairy Store API (1.0.0-draft)

Download OpenAPI specification:

Engineering: support@example.in License: LicenseRef-Proprietary

Public REST API for the storefront, admin panel, delivery agent app and Android app.

One API for every client. Read the API guide for conventions: authentication, errors, pagination, idempotency, money and dates.

  • Money is always an object with integer paise: { "amount": 6400, "currency": "INR" } = ₹64.00.
  • Business dates (YYYY-MM-DD) are dates in India Standard Time.
  • Errors use RFC 9457 application/problem+json; branch on code.
  • Endpoints that create money movements require an Idempotency-Key header.

Status: contract-first draft. Once the API exists this file is generated from Fastify route schemas and CI checks it against this contract.

Web clients (web, admin, agent) receive tokens as httpOnly cookies. Android receives accessToken and refreshToken in the body.
